info.title: NW-ITSM API
info.description: API v2 of NW-ITSM, served by the Rust backend next to the legacy PHP application.

get.summary: Lists the assets of a type visible to the session (templates excluded).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description:
Text searched in the name, serial number, inventory number (and UUID
of computers).

parameters.name: trash
parameters.description: List the items in the trash instead of the others.

403.description: No read right on this type

post.summary: Creates an asset in one of the selected entities.

403.description: No create right, or entity not selected

409.description: Another item has the same values (`duplicate`), or must be created in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

get.summary:
Values of a form field for an asset of the entity: the entity's own
values and the recursive ones of its parents, like the legacy dropdowns.

parameters.name: entity_id
parameters.description: Entity of the asset being edited: one of the selected entities.

400.description: Invalid parameters, or no such field for this type

403.description: No create or update right, or entity not selected

get.summary: Returns an asset visible to the session, including one in the trash.

403.description: No read right on this type

patch.summary:
Updates an asset of a selected entity. For computers, the changes of
contact, user, group, location (and status, depending on the settings)
are copied to the connected items and components, like the PHP code.

403.description: No update right, or entity not selected

409.description: Another item has the same values (`duplicate`), items of other entities use the shared item (`sharing_in_use`), or must be changed in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

post.summary: Restores an asset from the trash.

403.description: No delete right, or entity not selected

409.description: Must be done in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

post.summary: Moves an asset to the trash.

403.description: No delete right, or entity not selected

409.description: Must be done in the classic interface (`legacy_required`)

get.summary:
Opens a session from the PHP application (`front/nw_bridge.php`) and
redirects to the application. On failure, redirects to the login page.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token signed by the PHP application.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Page of the application to open (`/app/...`).

303.description: Redirection to the application or to the login page

post.summary: Issues a token opening the classic interface as the current user.

200.description: Token for the PHP application, nonce cookie set

post.summary: Logs in with a local ITSM-NG account and sets the session cookie.
post.description:
After 5 failures for a login from an address, or 20 from an address,
attempts are refused for 15 minutes.

403.description: Account disabled, password expired or no usable profile

post.summary:
Changes the password of the current user. The other sessions of the user
end; this one gets a new cookie.

200.description: Password changed, new session cookie set

400.description: Wrong current password, same or weak new password

post.summary: Replaces an expired password and logs in (legacy `updatepassword.php`).

400.description: Password not expired, same or weak new password

get.summary: Lists the entities the active profile can select.

put.summary: Selects the entities to work on (legacy entity selector).

200.description: Entities changed, new session cookie set

403.description: Entity not allowed for the profile

put.summary:
Activates another profile of the user, with its default entities (like
the legacy profile selector).

200.description: Profile changed, new session cookie set

403.description: Profile not granted or not usable

patch.summary:
Updates the preferences of the current user, with an entry in the
user's history.

entity_id.description: Entity of the new asset: one of the selected entities.

allOf.description: Connectors and features of the type, `null` for the other types.

duplicates.description:
After a write: items with the same values as this one, reported by
a unicity criterion that does not refuse them.

is_global.description: Used by several computers at once.

memory.description: Printers (free text) and network equipment (MiB) only.

oneOf.description: Computers, printers and network equipment only.

page_counter.description: Printers only: current counter of pages.

size.description: Monitors only: diagonal in inches, as stored (`"21.50"`).

oneOf.description: Computers only: how the computer is updated (inventory tool...).

is_global.description:
Monitors, printers, peripherals and phones only: one item for
several computers.

is_recursive.description: Visible in sub-entities. Can be set, not unset (classic interface).

memory.description:
Printers: free text. Network equipment: a whole number of MiB, or
empty.

network_id.description: Computers, printers and network equipment only.

size.description: Monitors only: decimal number of inches (`"21.5"`, `"21,5"`).

AssetFields.description:
Fields of a creation or an update. Absent fields are left unchanged;
`null` clears a field (empty text, no related object).

total.description: Number of matching assets on every page.

AssetPermissions.description: What the session may do with an asset.

trash.description: Move to the trash and restore.

AssetType.description: Type of asset, in the paths.

token.description:
To pass to `front/nw_bridge.php?token=...` within one minute, from
the same browser (a nonce cookie is set).

ChoiceField.description: A field of the asset forms offering a list of values.

items.description: At most 50 values, sorted by label.

DuplicateNotice.description: Items with the same values, reported but not refused.

entity_id.description: Entity to select; `null` selects every entity of the profile.

details.description:
More codes, for example the broken rules of `weak_password`
(`too_short`, `missing_digit`, `missing_lowercase`,
`missing_uppercase`, `missing_symbol`) or the reason of
`legacy_required` (`business_rules`, `field_unicity`,
`linked_items`, `notifications`, `plugins`), or the fields of a
`duplicate`.

Features.description: Connectors and features of monitors, printers and phones (`have_*`).

language.description:
Language code (`fr_FR`...), `null` for the default language. Absent:
unchanged.

Ref.description: A related object: id and display name.

name.description: `null` when the related row no longer exists.

level.description: Depth in the tree, 1 for the root.

recursive_allowed.description: It can be selected with its sub-entities.

bridge.description: The classic interface can be opened without logging in again.

change_password.description: The user can change their password here (local account and right).

recursive.description: The selected entity includes its sub-entities.

oneOf.description: Selected entity; `null` when every entity of the profile is selected.

profiles.description: Every profile granted to the user.

rights.description: Rights of the active profile, as legacy bitmasks per module.

language.description: Language in use (`fr_FR`...): the user's choice or the default one.

language_is_default.description: The language is the default one of the application.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Login, logout and the bridge with the classic interface

tags.name: session
tags.description: Current session: profile, entities, password, preferences
